title: French-Style Lamb Kebabs
description: Grilled lamb kebabs with a smoky flavor, inspired by French cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (180°C/356°F).
Thread the lamb cubes onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together the smoked paprika, olive oil, and chopped oregano.
Brush the mixture evenly onto the lamb cubes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your choice of sides, such as roasted vegetables or quinoa.
